notablePrerequisites:
Moon-Circuit Hacker does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
description:
Declare Moon-Circuit Hacker as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.
